items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 36:1
items.html: The first division is the smallness (Katnut) of the Nekudim, which came from the sockets of the eyes, which is the state of back to back (AB“A) of Aba ve Ima. The second division is from the new light that broke through the Parsa and descended and shone through the navel of Adam Kadmon, bringing the letter Hey down to its place, to the mouth of the Nekudim; and Aba ve Ima returned to the aspect of Rosh and attained their GAR, which is the state of face to back (PB“A) of Aba ve Ima, for Ima still does not turn her face to Aba, because it is a desire of grace. And the third division is the aspect of the Mayin Nukvin of Vav and a dot, which Aba ve Ima received from the Yesod of Adam Kadmon, which returned Aba ve Ima to the state of face to face, and they bore the Mochin of the seven lower (ZAT) of the Nekudim, all of them. (Inner Light, Item 624, Sub Header, “And in This You Will Understand That There Is”)
